headline: FDR's first speech as president, in the middle of a *bank panic*
quote: This nation is asking for action, and action now
title: FDR's first speech as president, during the 1933 bank panic
caption: March 4, 1933: banks across America were failing as Franklin D. Roosevelt took office. Newsreel footage of his inaugural address.
context: Two days later, he ordered *every bank in America* to close.
comment: Would you keep your savings in a bank in 1933? 👇
